content:
Here's a complete Crossplane XRD + Composition using functions mode.

## 1. XRD (CompositeResourceDefinition)

```yaml
# xrd.yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: CompositeResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: xappstacks.platform.example.org
spec:
  group: platform.example.org
  names:
    kind: XAppStack
    plural: xappstacks
  claimNames:
    kind: AppStack
    plural: appstacks
  versions:
    - name: v1alpha1
      served: true
      referenceable: true
      schema:
        openAPIV3Schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            spec:
              type: object
              properties:
                parameters:
                  type: object
                  properties:
                    environment:
                      type: string
                      enum: ["dev", "prod"]
                    region:
                      type: string
                      default: "us-east-1"
                    namePrefix:
                      type: string
                      description: Prefix for all created resource names.
                    rds:
                      type: object
                      properties:
                        instanceClass:
                          type: string
                          default: "db.t3.micro"
                        allocatedStorage:
                          type: integer
                          default: 20
                        multiAZ:
                          type: boolean
                          default: false
                        backupRetentionDays:
                          type: integer
                          default: 7
                          minimum: 7
                        masterUsername:
                          type: string
                          default: "appuser"
                      required:
                        - instanceClass
                    oidc:
                      type: object
                      description: OIDC trust configuration for IRSA role.
                      properties:
                        providerArn:
                          type: string
                        providerUrl:
                          type: string
                        serviceAccount:
                          type: string
                          description: "namespace:serviceaccount"
                  required:
                    - environment
                    - region
                    - namePrefix
                    - oidc
              required:
                - parameters
            status:
              type: object
              properties:
                bucketName:
                  type: string
                rdsEndpoint:
                  type: string
                roleArn:
                  type: string
```

## 2. Composition (functions mode)

```yaml
# composition.yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Composition
metadata:
  name: xappstack-aws
  labels:
    provider: aws
spec:
  compositeTypeRef:
    apiVersion: platform.example.org/v1alpha1
    kind: XAppStack
  mode: Pipeline
  writeConnectionSecretsToNamespace: crossplane-system
  pipeline:
    - step: patch-and-transform
      functionRef:
        name: function-patch-and-transform
      input:
        apiVersion: pt.fn.crossplane.io/v1beta1
        kind: Resources
        resources:

          # ---------------- S3 Bucket ----------------
          - name: s3-bucket
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: Bucket
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  region: us-east-1
                  # forceDestroy left false to protect data
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.namePrefix
                toFieldPath: metadata.annotations[crossplane.io/external-name]
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "%s-app-assets"
              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: metadata.annotations[crossplane.io/external-name]
                toFieldPath: status.bucketName

          - name: s3-versioning
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: BucketVersioning
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  region: us-east-1
                  bucketSelector:
                    matchControllerRef: true
                  versioningConfiguration:
                    - status: Enabled
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region

          - name: s3-encryption
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  region: us-east-1
                  bucketSelector:
                    matchControllerRef: true
                  rule:
                    - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
                        - sseAlgorithm: AES256
                      bucketKeyEnabled: true
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region

          - name: s3-public-access-block
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: BucketPublicAccessBlock
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  region: us-east-1
                  bucketSelector:
                    matchControllerRef: true
                  blockPublicAcls: true
                  blockPublicPolicy: true
                  ignorePublicAcls: true
                  restrictPublicBuckets: true
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region

          # ---------------- RDS PostgreSQL ----------------
          - name: rds-instance
            base:
              apiVersion: rds.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: Instance
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  region: us-east-1
                  engine: postgres
                  engineVersion: "15"
                  instanceClass: db.t3.micro
                  allocatedStorage: 20
                  username: appuser
                  autoGeneratePassword: true
                  passwordSecretRef:
                    namespace: crossplane-system
                    name: rds-master-password
                    key: password
                  # --- Acceptance criteria ---
                  deletionProtection: true
                  publiclyAccessible: false
                  storageEncrypted: true
                  backupRetentionPeriod: 7
                  skipFinalSnapshot: false
                  finalSnapshotIdentifier: appstack-final
                writeConnectionSecretToRef:
                  namespace: crossplane-system
                  name: rds-connection
            connectionDetails:
              - name: endpoint
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.endpoint
              - name: username
                fromFieldPath: spec.forProvider.username
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.rds.instanceClass
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.instanceClass
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.rds.allocatedStorage
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.allocatedStorage
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.rds.multiAZ
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.multiAz
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.rds.backupRetentionDays
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.backupRetentionPeriod
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.rds.masterUsername
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.username
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.namePrefix
                toFieldPath: metadata.annotations[crossplane.io/external-name]
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "%s-postgres"
              # unique per-stack connection secret name
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: metadata.uid
                toFieldPath: spec.writeConnectionSecretToRef.name
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "rds-conn-%s"
              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.endpoint
                toFieldPath: status.rdsEndpoint

          # ---------------- IAM Role (IRSA / service account) ----------------
          - name: iam-role
            base:
              apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: Role
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  assumeRolePolicy: |
                    {
                      "Version": "2012-10-17",
                      "Statement": []
                    }
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.namePrefix
                toFieldPath: metadata.annotations[crossplane.io/external-name]
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "%s-sa-role"
              # Build OIDC trust policy from parameters
              - type: CombineFromComposite
                combine:
                  variables:
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.oidc.providerArn
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.oidc.providerUrl
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.oidc.serviceAccount
                  strategy: string
                  string:
                    fmt: |
                      {
                        "Version": "2012-10-17",
                        "Statement": [
                          {
                            "Effect": "Allow",
                            "Principal": { "Federated": "%s" },
                            "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
                            "Condition": {
                              "StringEquals": {
                                "%s:sub": "system:serviceaccount:%s",
                                "%s:aud": "sts.amazonaws.com"
                              }
                            }
                          }
                        ]
                      }
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.assumeRolePolicy
              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.arn
                toFieldPath: status.roleArn

          # Least-privilege inline policy: only this stack's bucket
          - name: iam-role-policy
            base:
              apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: RolePolicy
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  roleSelector:
                    matchControllerRef: true
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.namePrefix
                toFieldPath: metadata.annotations[crossplane.io/external-name]
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "%s-s3-access"
              - type: CombineFromComposite
                combine:
                  variables:
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.namePrefix
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.namePrefix
                  strategy: string
                  string:
                    fmt: |
                      {
                        "Version": "2012-10-17",
                        "Statement": [
                          {
                            "Effect": "Allow",
                            "Action": [
                              "s3:GetObject",
                              "s3:PutObject",
                              "s3:ListBucket"
                            ],
                            "Resource": [
                              "arn:aws:s3:::%s-app-assets",
                              "arn:aws:s3:::%s-app-assets/*"
                            ]
                          }
                        ]
                      }
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.policy
```

## 3. Function installation

```yaml
# functions.yaml
apiVersion: pkg.crossplane.io/v1beta1
kind: Function
metadata:
  name: function-patch-and-transform
spec:
  package: xpkg.upbound.io/crossplane-contrib/function-patch-and-transform:v0.7.0
```

## 4. Environment claims (isolation via parameters)

**Dev:**
```yaml
# claim-dev.yaml
apiVersion: platform.example.org/v1alpha1
kind: AppStack
metadata:
  name: webapp
  namespace: dev
spec:
  parameters:
    environment: dev
    region: us-east-1
    namePrefix: webapp-dev
    rds:
      instanceClass: db.t3.micro
      allocatedStorage: 20
      multiAZ: false
      backupRetentionDays: 7
    oidc:
      providerArn: arn:aws:iam::111111111111:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEV
      providerUrl: oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEV
      serviceAccount: dev:webapp-sa
  compositionSelector:
    matchLabels:
      provider: aws
  writeConnectionSecretToRef:
    name: webapp-dev-conn
```

**Prod:**
```yaml
# claim-prod.yaml
apiVersion: platform.example.org/v1alpha1
kind: AppStack
metadata:
  name: webapp
  namespace: prod
spec:
  parameters:
    environment: prod
    region: us-east-1
    namePrefix: webapp-prod
    rds:
      instanceClass: db.t3.medium
      allocatedStorage: 100
      multiAZ: true
      backupRetentionDays: 14
    oidc:
      providerArn: arn:aws:iam::222222222222:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/PROD
      providerUrl: oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/PROD
      serviceAccount: prod:webapp-sa
  compositionSelector:
    matchLabels:
      provider: aws
  writeConnectionSecretToRef:
    name: webapp-prod-conn
```

## How the acceptance criteria are met

| Criterion | Implementation |
|---|---|
| **Bucket** versioning + encryption + no public | `BucketVersioning` (Enabled), `BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration` (AES256), `BucketPublicAccessBlock` (all blocks true) |
| **RDS** deletion protection, backups ≥7, not public | `deletionProtection: true`, `backupRetentionPeriod` (min 7 in schema), `publiclyAccessible: false`, `storageEncrypted: true` |
| **Secret** never plaintext | RDS password `autoGeneratePassword` → written to a `ProviderSecret` (`writeConnectionSecretToRef`); connection secret name is unique per composite (`metadata.uid`) so dev/prod never collide |
| **IAM** least privilege, no wildcards | Inline `RolePolicy` scoped to only this stack's bucket ARN + explicit actions (no `s3:*`) |
| **Environment isolation** | Separate claims in separate namespaces, independent composites, unique `namePrefix` and connection secrets — mutating the prod claim only reconciles prod's composite/MRs |

**Notes on scope:** The EKS cluster, CloudFront/ACM (HTTPS), and cross-region replication would be added as additional resources in the same pipeline (`Cluster`/`NodeGroup`, `Distribution` + `Certificate`, `BucketReplicationConfiguration` gated on `environment == prod`). I focused this deliverable on the three requested resources (S3, RDS, IAM). Let me know if you'd like the cluster + CloudFront resources added to complete the full spine.
